parameters.description: Update one node's fields in an n8n workflow (parameters are merged shallowly; also name/disabled/position/credentials/type/typeVersion/onError). CRITICAL — CONCURRENCY: this does a FULL-workflow read-modify-write with NO locking or version check, and the save uses neverError so conflicts are hidden. NEVER call this (or Add Node / Remove Node / Update Workflow) more than once at a time, in parallel, or back-to-back — concurrent calls race and the last write SILENTLY overwrites the others (this is why edits 'disappear'). Always mutate ONE node, then re-read it with Get Single Node to confirm it stuck before the next edit. CRITICAL — CODE FORMATTING: always write a Code node's jsCode as readable MULTI-LINE code with real newlines, indentation and comments. Multi-line jsCode saves fine here — never collapse it onto a single line.

parameters.content:
### 1. Set up your instance (the only edit needed)
Open **Config** and set:
- `host` - your n8n base URL, no trailing slash (e.g. `https://n8n.acme.com`)
- `api_key` - Settings > n8n API > Create an API key

Every HTTP node reads `$('Config').first().json.host` / `.api_key`, so nothing else changes.
`Parse Payload` JSON-parses the tool arguments (MCP delivers object args as strings).

### 2. The MCP surface
One tool node per action, all pointing back at this same workflow (`$workflow.id`) with a different `operation`.

**Activate the workflow**, then copy the URL from **n8n MCP Server** into your client (path: `n8n-mcp`). Change the path if another MCP server on this instance already uses it.

To remove an action from the surface, delete its tool node - the branch on the right just stops being reachable.

**Careful - this is full write access.** These tools can overwrite, deactivate and delete any workflow on the instance set in **Config**, and anyone you hand this to gets that power. Delete the tool nodes you don't want them to have (`Delete Workflow`, `Update Workflow`, `Update Node In Workflow`, `Remove Node From Workflow`, `Run Workflow`) before sharing it.

### 3. Router
`operation` picks the branch. Unknown operations hit **Stop and Error** so a typo fails loudly instead of returning nothing.
